hd.value: Oud perfume from Arabian, niche and designer houses

cp.value:
Oud perfume is built around agarwood, a dark, resinous material with a smoky, woody depth that lasts for hours on skin. This edit brings together 27 oud fragrances from Arabian, niche and designer houses, from £19.99, so you can find the style that suits you.

Arabian classics

Al Haramain's Amber Oud family is the easiest way in. Amber Oud Gold Edition (£29.99) is rich and sweet, the Tobacco Edition (£34.99) is warm and smoky, and Amber Oud Black Edition (£41.99) is deep and bold. La Maison de la Vanille Royal Oud (£19.99) adds a soft vanilla side, and Fumeri Oud Saffron for Men (£23.95) and SAP Saffron Oud (£37.95) pair the resin with spicy saffron.

Niche and designer oud

For something rarer, Montale's Aoud Safran (£54.99) and Aoud Damascus (£52.99) blend oud with saffron and rose, while Mancera Black Noir (£69.99) is dark and rich. Tiziana Terenzi's Gold Rose Oudh Extrait (£84.99) is a concentrated rose and oud. From the designer houses, Gucci Intense Oud (£73.99), Guerlain Oud Essentiel (£94.99) and Tom Ford Oud Wood (from £115.99) are smoother takes on the note. Acqua di Parma Oud & Spice (20 ml, £40.99) comes in a handy smaller size.

Oud is strong, so start with one or two sprays on the wrists or neck. Most of these scents are unisex, and many pair oud with amber, rose or spices. Explore the Oud fragrances scent family, our Arabian perfume page or the Al Haramain collection.

Every bottle is 100% authentic. We dispatch from within the UK, which makes this a simple place to buy oud perfume online in the UK, with free delivery when you spend over £40.

hd.value: Arabian perfume: oud, amber and musk

cp.value:
Arabian perfume is known for rich, long-lasting blends of oud, amber, musk and rose. This edit gathers 33 fragrances from Al Haramain, Signature D'orient and Armaf, from £19.99, ranging from fresh everyday scents to deep evening blends.

Al Haramain

Al Haramain's L'Aventure (£27.99) is fresh and confident, L'Aventure Blanche (£24.99) is crisp and clean, and L'Aventure Intense (£30.99) is bolder. Detour Noir (£19.99) is warm and smooth. For a softer, skin-like scent, Amber Musk (£39.99) blends warm amber with musk, and the Amber Oud editions bring in the resinous side of the house.

Signature D'orient

Signature D'orient has a wide line of 100 ml eaux de parfum, many sold with a 15 ml travel spray. Signature Blue (£38.99) is fresh and modern, Signature Aura (£74.95) is soft and radiant with a refillable travel spray, and Black Pour Homme (£38.99) is smooth and masculine. If you prefer a clean musk perfume, Musk Eau De Parfum (£64.99) comes with a 15 ml spray and funnel. Not sure where to start? The Signature Discovery Set (10 x 10 ml, £75.99) lets you try ten scents before choosing a full bottle.

Rounding out the edit, Armaf Hunter (£22.99) is a fresh, confident scent for men, and Signature Le Femme Gold (£42.99) is radiant and feminine. Explore our oud perfume page, the Amber fragrances family or the full Signature D'orient range.

All fragrances are 100% authentic and sent from the UK, and delivery is free on orders over £40.
